synopsis: Luisa is an uncompromising feminist, radical against patriarchy. Militates with passion, cancels without remorse, and does not tolerate anyone around him thinking differently. Ricardo, her partner, is a quiet and somewhat submissive psychologist who only wants to start a family with her, although Luisa considers motherhood a system trap. During a pro-abortion demonstration, Luisa is run over by the "truck of life" belonging to an ultra-Catholic group. When she wakes up, her personality has taken a complete turn: she dresses like a woman in her fifties, goes to mass, wants to have children, supports ultra-conservative ideas and is happy being a housewife. Ricardo, surprised, sees at first his greatest wish fulfilled. But he soon discovers that this new Luisa is homophobic, xenophobic and defender of a new kind of extremist ideas. Now, Ricardo, he will have to make a decision and find out which woman he is really in love with.
